notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Update notes: 

1.0.4 - 18/08/22
- Adjusted map scrolling in the last map of the Demo.
- Adjusted the save file of the demo and the main game to allow continuation of the story without creating a new game.

To move the DEMO save file to the Main game: 
Copy the contents of the game folder: 

DespectumDrakoneDemo/www/save

and paste it to the same address of the main game: 

DespectumDrakone/www/save

[b]*Consider that all save files inside the main game, will be deleted and overwritten, so it will not be usable. [/b]

notes.title: ¡Al fin en Steam!
notes.content:
Well, as is, Despectum Drakone has managed to enter Steam.
Now what continues is to polish the programming, the plots, check bugs, the location, etc. etc.

It has been an interesting and chaotic journey, but I think that is what has given it flavor.

And to think that it all started in a small notebook hehehe

Without a doubt, it is a job that could not have been completed alone and I have had the opportunity to have the help and support of great collaborators, programmers and artists who undoubtedly left their mark on both the game and me.

I have to keep working and hopefully the game will be released later this year.

How curious life is without a doubt ...
